entries.name: allow_always_on_autofill_in_apps
entries.title: Always On Autofill In Apps
entries.summary: Keeps autofill available while text is entered in apps, rather than limiting it to particular moments in the input flow.

entries.name: allow_contact_promo_dialog_in_smart_dictation
entries.title: Contact Promo Dialog In Smart Dictation
entries.summary: Allows Smart Dictation to display a dialog promoting contact-related features during voice input.

entries.name: allow_contact_request_in_regular_dictation
entries.title: Contact Request In Regular Dictation
entries.summary: Lets Gboard request access to contacts during regular voice typing; it does not itself grant permission.

entries.name: allow_contact_request_in_smart_dictation
entries.title: Contact Request In Smart Dictation
entries.summary: Lets Gboard request access to contacts during Smart Dictation; it does not itself grant permission.

entries.name: allow_metered_small_speech_pack_downloads
entries.title: Metered Small Speech Pack Downloads
entries.summary: Allows small speech-language pack downloads on metered connections, instead of requiring an unmetered network.

entries.name: allow_mixed_language_and_digits
entries.title: Mixed Language And Digits
entries.summary: Lets voice typing process speech that combines multiple languages and digits in one utterance.

entries.name: allow_other_network
entries.title: Other Network
entries.summary: Lets a networking library reuse cached domain-name lookup results after a network change; this does not describe a Gboard interface option.

entries.name: allow_pk_event_from_virtual_device
entries.title: PK Event From Virtual Device
entries.summary: This allows physical-keyboard events from virtual devices to reach Gboard's input handler.

entries.name: allow_port_migration
entries.title: Port Migration
entries.summary: Allows an active network connection to move to a different port without restarting the connection.

entries.name: allow_server_migration
entries.title: Server Migration
entries.summary: Allows an active network connection to migrate between servers without restarting the connection.

entries.name: allow_show_toast_in_popup_ime_window
entries.title: Show Toast In Popup Ime Window
entries.summary: Allows brief toast notifications to appear within a popup keyboard window during input.

entries.name: allow_space_and_comma
entries.title: Space And Comma
entries.summary: Allows Gboard's space bar and comma key to enter text during keyboard input.

entries.name: allow_u18_for_custom_sticker
entries.title: U18 For Custom Sticker
entries.summary: Allows accounts classified as under 18 to use custom-sticker features, subject to the app's other eligibility checks.

entries.name: disable_advanced_features_in_smart_dictation
entries.title: Advanced Features In Smart Dictation
entries.summary: Turns off advanced options in Gboard’s Smart Dictation voice-input flow; basic dictation availability is not specified.

entries.name: disable_at_the_cursor_feature
entries.title: At The Cursor Feature
entries.summary: Disables the near-cursor suggestion interface shown to users while editing text.

entries.name: disable_auxiliary_neural_decoder
entries.title: Auxiliary Neural Decoder
entries.summary: Turns off an auxiliary neural decoder used in Gboard’s text prediction system.

entries.name: disable_bidirectional_streams
entries.title: Bidirectional Streams
entries.summary: Turns off two-way data streams used for network communication with Gboard services.

entries.name: disable_case_fallback_for_pc_lm
entries.title: Case Fallback For Pc Lm
entries.summary: Turns off case fallback for Gboard’s language model labeled “PC”; the abbreviation’s meaning is unspecified.

entries.name: disable_comma_period_key_for_ios_switcher
entries.title: Comma Period Key For Ios Switcher
entries.summary: Disables the comma-and-period key in a Gboard layout identified as the iOS switcher.

entries.name: disable_contact_notice
entries.title: Contact Notice
entries.summary: Hides the contact-related notice shown in Gboard’s interface; its wording and display conditions are unspecified.

entries.name: disable_contact_promo_extension
entries.title: Contact Promo Extension
entries.summary: Disables the extension that promotes contacts within Gboard’s contact flow and interface.

entries.name: disable_content_suggestion
entries.title: Content Suggestion
entries.summary: Suppresses content suggestions in the relevant Gboard interface, without specifying what content is suggested or where.

entries.name: disable_correction_storage
entries.title: Correction Storage
entries.summary: Stops Gboard from storing correction data associated with its text-input workflows.

entries.name: disable_cross_profile_usage_store
entries.title: Cross Profile Usage Store
entries.summary: Disables the store that retains usage records across user profiles, preventing cross-profile usage data from being stored.

entries.name: disable_extended_spellchecker_locales
entries.title: Extended Spellchecker Locales
entries.summary: Removes extended locale support from spell-checking, limiting correction to locales supported by the remaining configuration.

entries.name: disable_fast_access_bar
entries.title: Fast Access Bar
entries.summary: Hides Gboard's quick-emoji row above the keys (the fast-access bar), not the separate main toolbar.

entries.name: disable_genai_cache
entries.title: Genai Cache
entries.summary: Turns off caching for generative AI, so repeated requests may require additional processing.

entries.name: disable_gm3_color_token_overrides
entries.title: Gm3 Color Token Overrides
entries.summary: Disables Material 3 color-token overrides for affected components of the Gboard interface.

entries.name: disable_gm3_energy_colors_in_legacy_themes
entries.title: Gm3 Energy Colors In Legacy Themes
entries.summary: Removes Material 3 energy-color styling from Gboard interface surfaces using legacy themes.

entries.name: disable_hide_nav_bar
entries.title: Hide Nav Bar
entries.summary: Keeps the system navigation bar visible with Gboard by disabling the behavior that hides it.

entries.name: disable_if_flag_is_false
entries.title: If Flag Is False
entries.summary: Disables a dependent behavior whenever its associated configuration flag evaluates to false.

entries.name: disable_if_flag_is_true
entries.title: If Flag Is True
entries.summary: Disables a dependent behavior whenever its associated configuration flag evaluates to true.

entries.name: disable_if_preference_is_false
entries.title: If Preference Is False
entries.summary: When its associated preference is false, this rule disables the dependent behavior; the preference and behavior are not identified.

entries.name: disable_if_preference_is_true
entries.title: If Preference Is True
entries.summary: When its associated preference is true, this rule disables the dependent behavior; the preference and behavior are not identified.

entries.name: disable_inline_suggestions
entries.title: Inline Suggestions
entries.summary: Stops Gboard from displaying predicted text inline in the composing area as you type.

entries.name: disable_ipv6_on_wifi
entries.title: Ipv6 On Wifi
entries.summary: Disables IPv6 for Gboard network connections over Wi-Fi, without changing Android's system-wide IPv6 setting.

entries.name: disable_lift_to_tap
entries.title: Lift To Tap
entries.summary: Disables Gboard's lift-to-tap interaction during keyboard input; the specific gesture behavior is not identified.

entries.name: disable_load_v2_klp
entries.title: Load V2 Klp
entries.summary: Purpose unknown — switches off a second-generation KLP loader; the KLP component hasn't been identified.

entries.name: disable_new_language_prompt_in_test
entries.title: New Language Prompt In Test
entries.summary: Suppresses the prompt for a newly added language in test flows; ordinary language setup behavior is not specified.

entries.name: disable_nwp_in_pk_vertical_mode
entries.title: NWP In PK Vertical Mode
entries.summary: Prevents next-word prediction (NWP) while a physical keyboard is in vertical mode.

entries.name: disable_nwp_result_cache
entries.title: NWP Result Cache
entries.summary: Prevents Gboard from reusing cached next-word prediction results, so predictions are calculated without that result cache.

entries.name: disable_ondevice_auto_download
entries.title: Ondevice Auto Download
entries.summary: Stops automatic downloading of on-device resources; features requiring those resources may not work until they are available.

entries.name: disable_pk_when_virtual_device_present
entries.title: PK When Virtual Device Present
entries.summary: When a virtual device is present, this prevents Gboard from handling a physical keyboard.

entries.name: disable_popup_view_outside_touch
entries.title: Popup View Outside Touch
entries.summary: Disables popup-view handling of touches outside the popup; whether those touches pass through or dismiss it is unspecified.

entries.name: disable_profiling_on_aarch64
entries.title: Profiling On Aarch64
entries.summary: Prevents profiling when Gboard runs on AArch64, the 64-bit processor architecture used by many Android devices.

entries.name: disable_refresh_in_result_page_emoji_kitchen_browse_search
entries.title: Refresh In Result Page Emoji Kitchen Browse Search
entries.summary: Disables refresh behavior on Emoji Kitchen’s browse-and-search results page; its trigger is unspecified.

entries.name: disable_remove_suggestion
entries.title: Remove Suggestion
entries.summary: Disables removal of displayed predictions from the suggestion strip through Gboard's keyboard interface.

entries.name: disable_smart_dictation_with_network_connection
entries.title: Smart Dictation With Network Connection
entries.summary: Turns off Smart Dictation while Gboard has a network connection; behavior when the device is offline is not described.

entries.name: disable_speech_enhancement_languages
entries.title: Speech Enhancement Languages
entries.summary: Turns off speech enhancement for supported voice-typing languages; the affected languages are not identified.

entries.name: disable_split_prompt_module
entries.title: Split Prompt Module
entries.summary: Disables Gboard’s split-prompt module; its role in the keyboard layout is unspecified.

entries.name: disable_system_globe_key
entries.title: System Globe Key
entries.summary: Disables some Gboard behavior involving the system globe key, but the affected behavior is not specified.

entries.name: disable_tls_zero_rtt
entries.title: Tls Zero Rtt
entries.summary: Disables TLS 0-RTT (early data) on affected connections, so application data waits until the standard TLS handshake completes.

entries.name: disable_writing_tools_item_move_animation
entries.title: Writing Tools Item Move Animation
entries.summary: Disables animation when items move within the list in Gboard's Writing Tools interface.

entries.name: emoji_kitchen_browse_skip_content_suggestion_display_condition
entries.title: Emoji Kitchen Browse Skip Content Suggestion Display Condition
entries.summary: Bypasses the usual condition for displaying content suggestions while browsing Emoji Kitchen.

entries.name: emoji_kitchen_data_cleanup_work
entries.title: Emoji Kitchen Data Cleanup Work
entries.summary: Runs cleanup on stored Emoji Kitchen data in Gboard; the data and cleanup schedule are unspecified.

entries.name: emoji_kitchen_for_zero_state_emojis_timeout
entries.title: Emoji Kitchen For Zero State Emojis Timeout
entries.summary: Sets a timeout for zero-state emojis during Emoji Kitchen browsing; the duration and ending condition are unspecified.

entries.name: emoji_kitchen_gemma_score_threshold_for_search
entries.title: Emoji Kitchen Gemma Score Threshold For Search
entries.summary: Sets the minimum relevance score for matches from Emoji Kitchen's AI search using Gemma.

entries.name: emoji_kitchen_gemma_search_for_contextual_ek_timeout_millis
entries.title: Emoji Kitchen Gemma Search For Contextual Ek Timeout Millis
entries.summary: Sets how long, in milliseconds, Emoji Kitchen's contextual search can use the Gemma AI model before timing out.

entries.name: emoji_kitchen_mdd_data_file_group
entries.title: Emoji Kitchen MDD Data File Group
entries.summary: Identifies the download group for Emoji Kitchen resources managed through Google's Mobile Data Download (MDD) system.

entries.name: emoji_kitchen_scam_index_data_file_group
entries.title: Emoji Kitchen Scam Index Data File Group
entries.summary: Names the downloaded files associated with Emoji Kitchen's similarity-search index; the meaning of “SCAM” is undocumented.

entries.name: emoji_kitchen_scam_index_init_delay_ms
entries.title: Emoji Kitchen Scam Index Init Delay Ms
entries.summary: Sets the delay, in milliseconds, before Gboard initializes Emoji Kitchen's similarity-search index.

entries.name: emoji_kitchen_scam_nearest_neighbors_cache_size
entries.title: Emoji Kitchen Scam Nearest Neighbors Cache Size
entries.summary: Limits how many nearby matches Emoji Kitchen's similarity-search index keeps in its reusable results cache.

entries.name: emoji_kitchen_search_result_ordering_strategy
entries.title: Emoji Kitchen Search Result Ordering Strategy
entries.summary: Chooses the ordering strategy for Emoji Kitchen search results; available strategies are not documented.

entries.name: emoji_kitchen_sticker_scaling_fife_url_suffix
entries.title: Emoji Kitchen Sticker Scaling Fife Url Suffix
entries.summary: Adds image-scaling instructions to the FIFE image URL used to fetch or display Emoji Kitchen stickers.

entries.name: enable_3d_couple_emojis
entries.title: 3d Couple Emojis
entries.summary: Selects an experimental three-dimensional presentation for couple emoji when Gboard has compatible artwork available.

entries.name: enable_ac_threshold
entries.title: Ac Threshold
entries.summary: Enables an autocorrection confidence threshold, helping Gboard decide when a suggested replacement is reliable enough to apply automatically.
entries.researchNote: Interpretation based on established terminology or the named operation; the exact Gboard flag's runtime effect has not been independently verified.

references.label: Google Gboard research — AC means auto correction (flag effect inferred)

entries.name: enable_access_point_keyboard
entries.title: Access Point Keyboard
entries.summary: Adds keyboard controls that let users navigate shortcuts and tools in Gboard’s toolbar.

entries.name: enable_access_points_customization_hint
entries.title: Access Points Customization Hint
entries.summary: Displays guidance about customizing toolbar access points, the shortcuts or tools available from Gboard’s toolbar.

entries.name: enable_access_points_menu_redesign
entries.title: Access Points Menu Redesign
entries.summary: Changes the menu used to choose toolbar access points, presenting a redesigned way to browse available toolbar tools.

entries.name: enable_access_points_new_education
entries.title: Access Points New Education
entries.summary: Presents updated guidance about toolbar access points, the shortcuts or tools available from Gboard’s toolbar.

entries.name: enable_action_key_on_voice_toolbar
entries.title: Action Key On Voice Toolbar
entries.summary: Adds an action-key control to Gboard’s voice toolbar alongside dictation controls; its command is unspecified.

entries.name: enable_add_punctuation_into_dynamic_art_sticker
entries.title: Add Punctuation Into Dynamic Art Sticker
entries.summary: Enables Gboard to handle punctuation in text associated with dynamic art stickers.

entries.name: enable_adjust_default_keyboard_height
entries.title: Adjust Default Keyboard Height
entries.summary: Enables adjustment of Gboard’s default keyboard height; the interface and adjustment method are unspecified.

entries.name: enable_agentic_dictation
entries.title: Agentic Dictation
entries.summary: Uses Rambler-style voice typing, which can clean up dictated text and follow spoken editing instructions.

entries.name: enable_agentic_dictation_debug_ui
entries.title: Agentic Dictation Debug UI
entries.summary: Adds diagnostic interface elements for inspecting agentic dictation state in Gboard’s voice-input workflow.

entries.name: enable_ai_core_embedding_gemma
entries.title: AI Core Embedding Gemma
entries.summary: Uses Gemma through Android AICore to represent text by meaning, helping Gboard match related phrases instead of only exact words.

entries.name: enable_ai_core_llm
entries.title: AI Core LLM
entries.summary: Enables Gboard to use language-model capabilities through Android AI Core, an on-device AI service; the consuming feature is unspecified.

entries.name: enable_animated_emoji_content_suggestions
entries.title: Animated Emoji Content Suggestions
entries.summary: Adds animated emoji-style items to Gboard’s content suggestions, making them available alongside other suggested rich content.

entries.name: enable_audio_silence_callback
entries.title: Audio Silence Callback
entries.summary: Signals when incoming audio becomes silent in the voice typing flow, so speech recognition can respond to pauses.

entries.name: enable_auto_correction_stats
entries.title: Auto Correction Stats
entries.summary: Records auto-correction statistics for diagnostics; these are internal measurements, not a user-facing Gboard setting.

entries.name: enable_auto_fill_pk_fallback_ui
entries.title: Auto Fill PK Fallback UI
entries.summary: Provides a fallback autofill interface for physical-keyboard (PK) text entry, with recovery controls in the keyboard’s input flow.

entries.name: enable_auto_float_keyboard_in_freeform
entries.title: Auto Float Keyboard In Freeform
entries.summary: Uses a floating Gboard layout automatically in freeform windows, where apps can be displayed in movable, resizable windows.

entries.name: enable_auto_float_keyboard_in_landscape
entries.title: Auto Float Keyboard In Landscape
entries.summary: Floats Gboard automatically in landscape orientation when supported, instead of keeping it docked at the screen edge.

entries.name: enable_auto_float_keyboard_in_multi_window
entries.title: Auto Float Keyboard In Multi Window
entries.summary: Floats Gboard automatically in Android multi-window mode when supported, adapting keyboard placement while multiple app windows are visible.

entries.name: enable_auto_space_setting
entries.title: Auto Space Setting
entries.summary: Controls Gboard’s automatic-spacing settings, rather than directly specifying when the keyboard inserts a space.

entries.name: enable_auto_split_for_android_messenger
entries.title: Auto Split For Android Messenger
entries.summary: Enables automatic splitting of Gboard’s keyboard for use in Android Messenger contexts.

entries.name: enable_autofill_ime_integration
entries.title: Autofill Ime Integration
entries.summary: Connects Gboard with Android autofill so it can coordinate keyboard text entry with filling form fields.

entries.name: enable_avt_by_default_for_multilang
entries.title: Avt By Default For Multilang
entries.summary: Selects Advanced Voice Typing by default for multilingual voice typing when the configured languages are supported.

entries.name: enable_back_to_prime_as_top_level
entries.title: Back To Prime As Top Level
entries.summary: Makes Gboard’s main typing keyboard a direct return destination from other keyboard screens, rather than routing through intermediate panels.

entries.name: enable_backup_delight5_personalized_data
entries.title: Backup Delight5 Personalized Data
entries.summary: Includes personalized data from Gboard’s Delight5 prediction model in its backup data.

entries.name: enable_beep_sound_at_recognition_end
entries.title: Beep Sound At Recognition End
entries.summary: Plays a beep when speech recognition finishes, providing an audible cue that the voice typing recognition pass has ended.

entries.name: enable_best_frame_search_for_logging
entries.title: Best Frame Search For Logging
entries.summary: Enables a diagnostic search for the best frame to record in logs, rather than treating every captured frame equally.

entries.name: enable_biasing_for_commands
entries.title: Biasing For Commands
entries.summary: Biases prediction ranking toward command-related words while typing, prioritizing command vocabulary in suggested candidates.

entries.name: enable_biasing_for_contact_fields
entries.title: Biasing For Contact Fields
entries.summary: Adjusts text suggestions for contact fields toward names or address-related terms, helping predictions fit the field being filled.

entries.name: enable_biasing_for_contacts
entries.title: Biasing For Contacts
entries.summary: Ranks contact names more prominently among Gboard’s typing suggestions, bringing address-book entries into prediction results.

entries.name: enable_biasing_for_past_corrections
entries.title: Biasing For Past Corrections
entries.summary: Uses earlier corrections to influence later word suggestions, so repeated corrections can affect prediction ranking.

entries.name: enable_biasing_metrics_logging
entries.title: Biasing Metrics Logging
entries.summary: Logs measurements about prediction biasing for diagnostics; these records are not a user-facing Gboard setting.

entries.name: enable_blocklist_for_proactive_emoji_kitchen
entries.title: Blocklist For Proactive Emoji Kitchen
entries.summary: Excludes blocked emoji combinations from proactive Emoji Kitchen suggestions, limiting which mashups Gboard may recommend.

entries.name: enable_browse_featured_pack
entries.title: Browse Featured Pack
entries.summary: Adds a featured-pack browsing area to the emoji content browser, making highlighted packs easier to discover.

entries.name: enable_call_to_perform_pix_operation
entries.title: Call To Perform Pix Operation
entries.summary: Purpose unknown — calls an internal PIX operation; neither the operation nor its visible effect is identified.

entries.name: enable_camera_permission_overlay
entries.title: Camera Permission Overlay
entries.summary: Adds a camera-permission prompt when a Gboard tool requests camera-based scanning, making the required access request visible.

entries.name: enable_clip_item_consumers
entries.title: Clip Item Consumers
entries.summary: Enables handlers for richer clipboard item types, so Gboard can process items beyond plain text.

entries.name: enable_clipboard_query_refactoring
entries.title: Clipboard Query Refactoring
entries.summary: Reorganizes how the toolbar and editing code retrieves clipboard items; this is an internal change, not a new clipboard control.

entries.name: enable_close_proactive_suggestions_access_point
entries.title: Close Proactive Suggestions Access Point
entries.summary: Adds a dismissal action for proactive suggestion surfaces, allowing users to close these suggestions from their entry point.

entries.name: enable_compound_word_suffix_prediction_language
entries.title: Compound Word Suffix Prediction Language
entries.summary: Provides language-specific suffix predictions for compound words, helping complete later parts as the user types through a word.

entries.name: enable_compound_word_support_language
entries.title: Compound Word Support Language
entries.summary: Adds compound-word handling for a supported language, improving how Gboard recognizes and predicts words formed from multiple joined parts.

entries.name: enable_concept_prediction_engine
entries.title: Concept Prediction Engine
entries.summary: Concept prediction can influence which text suggestions Gboard generates or ranks while you type.

entries.name: enable_contextual_gif_search_query_suggestion
entries.title: Contextual GIF Search Query Suggestion
entries.summary: Offers GIF search query suggestions based on the text context, helping users find relevant GIFs without typing a full search.

entries.name: enable_contextual_search_desktop_entrypoints
entries.title: Contextual Search Desktop Entrypoints
entries.summary: Adds entry points to contextual search in desktop-style interfaces, making search access available from supported keyboard or windowing surfaces.

entries.name: enable_conv_data_on_predefined_styles
entries.title: Conv Data On Predefined Styles
entries.summary: Purpose unknown — a data-handling option associated with predefined styles; 'conv' has not been reliably identified.

entries.name: enable_conversation_id_in_training_cache
entries.title: Conversation Id In Training Cache
entries.summary: Stores conversation identifiers alongside records in Gboard’s internal training cache, creating a privacy-sensitive link to conversations.

entries.name: enable_conversation_id_module
entries.title: Conversation Id Module
entries.summary: Enables an internal conversation-ID component for associating related input or assistant interactions.

entries.name: enable_correction_commit_animation
entries.title: Correction Commit Animation
entries.summary: Animates the moment Gboard commits an automatic correction, providing visible feedback that the typed text has changed.

entries.name: enable_crank_for_primary_locale_in_multilingual
entries.title: Crank For Primary Locale In Multilingual
entries.summary: Uses Crank, Gboard's prediction engine, for the primary language during multilingual typing.

entries.title: Crowdsource Integration
entries.summary: Connects Gboard with Google's Crowdsource typing activities, where volunteers contribute examples that help improve keyboard accuracy.

entries.title: Custom Sticker Naive Prompt Expander
entries.summary: Uses a simple prompt-expansion method when creating custom stickers, elaborating the text prompt used for generation.

entries.name: enable_custom_sticker_tab
entries.title: Custom Sticker Tab
entries.summary: Adds a dedicated tab for custom stickers in Gboard, providing a separate place to access sticker-creation features.

entries.name: enable_custom_sticker_tab_loading_indicator
entries.title: Custom Sticker Tab Loading Indicator
entries.summary: Displays a loading indicator while content for the custom-sticker tab is loading.

entries.name: enable_debug_toast_for_proactive_emoji_kitchen
entries.title: Debug Toast For Proactive Emoji Kitchen
entries.summary: Displays diagnostic toast messages for proactive Emoji Kitchen suggestions, exposing debugging information rather than adding a user-facing suggestion control.

entries.name: enable_decoder_response_wait_without_lock
entries.title: Decoder Response Wait Without Lock
entries.summary: Allows the decoder to wait for a response without holding a lock, changing synchronization behavior rather than adding a keyboard control.

entries.name: enable_delete_user_dictionary_typos
entries.title: Delete User Dictionary Typos
entries.summary: Lets typo entries be removed from Gboard's user dictionary, so unwanted misspellings need not remain available as learned words.

entries.name: enable_desktop_windowing_app_to_web_education
entries.title: Desktop Windowing App To Web Education
entries.summary: Shows Android desktop-windowing guidance for moving from an app to its website; this is a platform feature, not a Gboard keyboard feature.

entries.name: enable_deterministic_audio_track_release
entries.title: Deterministic Audio Track Release
entries.summary: Makes audio-track resource release timing predictable during voice typing, without adding a visible dictation control.

entries.name: enable_device_intelligence
entries.title: Device Intelligence
entries.summary: Provides an integration path between Gboard and Android's device-intelligence capabilities; supported services vary by device.

entries.name: enable_dictation_feature_split_install
entries.title: Dictation Feature Split Install
entries.summary: Allows voice typing components to be installed separately from Gboard, rather than bundled with the main keyboard package.

entries.name: enable_display_cutout_customization
entries.title: Display Cutout Customization
entries.summary: Supports Gboard layout adjustments around display cutouts and other usable-screen boundaries on the device.

entries.name: enable_docked_desk
entries.title: Docked Desk
entries.summary: Purpose unknown — a docked-desk component with no documented keyboard behavior.

entries.name: enable_dual_stream_biasing_arbitration
entries.title: Dual Stream Biasing Arbitration
entries.summary: Coordinates which of two bias-adjusted prediction streams is used for text prediction.

entries.name: enable_dup_key_fix
entries.title: Dup Key Fix
entries.summary: Adds a correction path for duplicate key-input events, addressing repeated input handling without introducing a new keyboard control.

entries.title: Dynamic Art
entries.summary: Makes Dynamic Art sticker generation available as an expression option, alongside existing sticker assets.

entries.name: enable_dynamic_art_debug_toast
entries.title: Dynamic Art Debug Toast
entries.summary: Displays toast notifications with debugging status for Dynamic Art, rather than providing a user-facing sticker control.

entries.name: enable_dynamic_art_language_tags
entries.title: Dynamic Art Language Tags
entries.summary: Adds language tags to Dynamic Art content; the flag concerns metadata, not a language-selection control.

entries.name: enable_dynamic_lm_noise_filter
entries.title: Dynamic Lm Noise Filter
entries.summary: Applies the dynamic language model's noise filter during voice typing, affecting speech-recognition processing rather than keyboard text entry.

entries.name: enable_dynamic_lm_unigram_continuation_scoring
entries.title: Dynamic Lm Unigram Continuation Scoring
entries.summary: Uses unigram (single-word) continuation scores in the dynamic language model to assess candidate word sequences during voice recognition.

entries.title: Dynamic Trainer
entries.summary: Activates Gboard's dynamic training component, which can update prediction-related learning data instead of relying only on a fixed model.

entries.title: Early Capture Decoder State
entries.summary: Captures the prediction decoder's state earlier in processing, making a snapshot available for inspection during model or input-processing diagnostics.

entries.name: enable_email_provider_completion
entries.title: Email Provider Completion
entries.summary: Provides completion suggestions for email providers as users enter an email address.

entries.name: enable_embedded_photo_picker
entries.title: Embedded Photo Picker
entries.summary: Select photos in a picker embedded within a keyboard-related surface instead of opening a separate picker.

entries.name: enable_embedded_photo_picker_leak_fix

entries.name: is_primary_for_emoji_2

entries.name: is_speech_enhancement_enabled

entries.name: max_num_rendered_content_suggestions

entries.name: min_num_of_edited_words_for_rephrase_promo

entries.name: pref_ai_writing_tools_enabled

entries.name: pref_clipboard_content_max_lines_custom

entries.name: pref_clipboard_max_count

entries.name: pref_clipboard_max_count_custom

entries.name: pref_clipboard_order_index_mode

entries.name: pref_clipboard_show_countdown

entries.name: pref_clipboard_show_order_index

entries.summary: Records whether Gboard's editing toolbar actions, such as Copy, Cut, and Paste, are enabled.

entries.title: English Uppercase Toggle Enabled

entries.title: Floating Web Search Browser Provider

entries.name: pref_frosted_glass_keytop_alpha

entries.name: pref_frosted_glass_transparency_mode
entries.title: Frosted Glass Transparency Mode
